name: Lucky Rabbit Reflex!
source:
An otome (GxB) dating simulation game, Lucky Rabbit Reflex sees our seventeen-year old heroine beginning her first and final year at a new school. Will she find friendship - or even romance - amongst the motley crew at Northmain College?

[From [url=http://www.luckyrabbitreflex.com]Official Website[/url]]
